name: tweet-grid
title: Tweet Grid
blurb: Responsive masonry grid of tweet cards with tunable columns and spacing.
description: CSS-based masonry layout using CSS Columns to arrange tweets responsively. Supports 1-5 columns with configurable spacing between items. Uses break-inside-avoid to prevent tweet cards from splitting.
use_when: Displaying multiple tweets in a gallery or wall format with automatic column wrapping.
avoid_when: Older browsers without CSS Columns support; the component relies on break-inside-avoid.
a11y: Semantic structure with proper spacing; no interactive elements beyond standard card behavior.
